aut_lower_bound.reason: all 2^40 coordinate sign changes preserve the Construction-A lattice; the permutation automorphisms of C_2(W) contain Aut(W(3,3)) = W(E6) (Pass 91).

mass.note: standard mass = even-UNIMODULAR reference; Lambda_C's own (non-unimodular) genus mass differs by a 2-adic factor for the 2^{+8} block but is of the same astronomical scale. h >= mass => the dim-40 genus is vast.

reading: The W(3,3) code-lattice Lambda_C is a rank-40 even lattice of genus II_{40,0}(2^{+8}) -- unimodular away from 2, with the E8/2E8 = O+_8(2) form at 2 -- and enormous symmetry |Aut| >= 2^40 * |W(E6)|.  Where dimension 8 has the single class E8, dimension 40 has an astronomically populated genus (mass ~ 1e51), placing Lambda_C among a vast family that shares its E8-at-2 discriminant form.
